title: Signal catalogue entries must record a full fix history
description: Signals currently record picked_up_at and fix_branch for the most recent fix attempt only. When a signal closes and later reopens — as the patch_file errors have done across four separate catalogue entries — there is no record of prior fix attempts. It is impossible to detect that a recurring problem has already been addressed and failed, which would indicate that a redesign rather than another fix is required.
proposed_resolution: Add a fix_history array to the signal schema. Each entry records: fix_branch, initiating_run_id, outcome (merged | abandoned | reverted), and closed_at timestamp. When signal_fix picks up a signal, it appends a new entry to fix_history rather than overwriting picked_up_at. The fix_signal tool must be updated to write fix_history entries on pickup and on resolution. Migrate existing picked_up_at and fix_branch fields into fix_history[0] for backwards compatibility.
